name: claude-reset-ping
description: Shows Claude 5h usage in the status bar and submits a per-session message into the live session when the 5 hour window resets. Needs the patched anthropic.claude-code (claude-vscode.sendToSession).

commands.title: Claude Reset Ping: Fire Armed Sessions Now (test)

claudeResetPing.defaultMessage.description: Message used when a session is armed without a custom one.

claudeResetPing.rearm.description: Keep a session armed after sending, so it fires again at the next reset. Off means one-shot.

claudeResetPing.pollSeconds.description: How often to re-evaluate (fire checks, status bar). Usage itself is fetched at most every 3 minutes, shared across windows.
